# 11. G-Computation Analysis

## 11.1 Scenario Differences in Survival

```{r}
#| label: gcomp-analysis
#| echo: true
#| eval: true


# Load and format G-computation scenario differences
gcomp_global_summary <- readRDS("Gcomp/gcomp_global_summary.rds")

gcomp_global_summary_graph <- gcomp_global_summary |>
  mutate(
    scenario_short = case_when(
      str_detect(Scenario, "Direct")   ~ "Direct",
      str_detect(Scenario, "Indirect") ~ "Indirect",
      str_detect(Scenario, "Total")    ~ "Total"
    ),
    exposure = case_when(
      exposure %in% c("DaysCount", "Duration") ~ "Snow cover duration",
      exposure == "MedianDensity"              ~ "Snow median density",
      exposure == "Snowdepth"                  ~ "Snow depth",
      TRUE                                     ~ exposure
    ),
    age = case_when(
      age == "prime"                        ~ "Prime age",
      age %in% c("senescent") ~ "Senescent",
      TRUE                                  ~ age
    )
  )

gcomp_graph <- ggplot(gcomp_global_summary_graph, aes(x = scenario_short, y = diff_abs, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  facet_grid(age ~ exposure) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.16, 0.12),
    breaks = seq(-0.15, 0.10, by = 0.05),
    labels = c("-0.15", "-0.10", "-0.05", "0.00", "0.05", "0.10")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#7a2554", "Male" = "#dd9a0a")) +
  labs(
    x    = "Scenario",
    y    = "Absolute difference in survival probability",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_pubr(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

gcomp_graph

# Summary table export
gcomp_table <- flextable(gcomp_global_summary) |> autofit()
doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, gcomp_table)   
print(doc, target = "result_gcomp.docx")
```
